title: Facebook Ads for Pet Grooming: A Guide for Mobile Groomers

facts.fact: The vendor's page states that Meta groups its ad objectives into six options: Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads, App promotion and Sales.
facts.quote: Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads, App promotion and Sales.

facts.fact: The vendor's page states that Meta's zip or postal code targeting accepts up to 50,000 codes.
The vendor's page is dated October 9, 2026.
The vendor offers a free 15-minute call to prospective clients, according to its own page.
